calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Yoto
calls.summary: James Shannon (GrowthBook, EMEA lead) demoed the platform to Amelie Bruhat (Lead Product Analyst at Yoto), addressing Yoto's pain points with fragmented data, an expensive frontend-only AB Tasty tool, and the need for cross-platform experimentation (web and app). GrowthBook offers warehouse-native feature flagging and A/B testing that integrates with their BigQuery data, enabling backend testing and identity stitching. Next steps: James will send slides, case studies, and pricing; Amelie will engage PMs and engineers, then schedule a technical demo with the broader team to meet Yoto’s September event deadline.
